Name: Ignirix
Description: A volatile fire beast that lunges headfirst into battle, burning hot and fast with little regard for defense.

Name: Emrix
Description: A small fire sprite that darts forward with quick, reckless bites of flame.

Name: Emrixen
Description: Its flames grow steadier and stronger, trading some speed for sharper, burning strikes.

Name: Pyren
Description: A fully ignited fire beast that overwhelms foes with fast, searing assaults.

Name: Flaren
Description: A heavily armored fire brute that smashes through enemies with explosive force and relentless heat.

Name: Budrel
Description: A gentle sprout creature that supports allies while pecking foes with hardened leaves.

Name: Vinel
Description: Its body thickens with vines, offering stronger protection and steadier healing presence.

Name: Flororn
Description: A mature forest guardian that shields allies and strikes back with controlled, verdant force.

Name: Thornel
Description: A hardened forest sentinel that advances slowly, striking with crushing vines and enduring immense punishment.

Name: Petorn
Description: A swift grass hunter that darts through foliage, striking at openings with sharp petals before retreating.

Name: Riplo
Description: A small aquatic crawler that snaps with watery bites and reacts quickly to threats.

Name: Riplon
Description: Its body hardens with flowing armor, striking back harder as battles drag on.

Name: Tideron
Description: A powerful water beast that balances offense and defense, crashing into foes with tidal force.

Name: Maril
Description: A calm but calculating water dweller that restrains foes with coiling currents before striking decisively.

Name: Torrin
Description: A massive aquatic guardian that absorbs punishment and retaliates with crushing waves of condensed water.

Name: Zapel
Description: A jittery electric critter that darts forward to shock foes before they can react.

Name: Zaprix
Description: Its body crackles with stable current, moving faster and striking harder with precise electric cuts.

Name: Voltek
Description: A compact electric enforcer that channels stored charge into repeated, driving strikes without slowing down.

Name: Strikon
Description: An elite electric predator that waits for the perfect moment before unleashing devastating, high-voltage strikes.

Name: Glasir
Description: A cautious ice dweller that hardens its body against attacks while chipping away at foes with chilling strikes.

Name: Frozel
Description: A compact ice creature that braces itself behind thick frost plating while striking cautiously.

Name: Frosen
Description: A hardened frost guardian that stands firm and retaliates with crushing, cold-laden blows.

Name: Crystir
Description: A towering ice colossus formed of dense crystal plates, advancing slowly while shattering foes with overwhelming frozen force.

Name: Burrel
Description: A squat ground dweller that braces itself in the soil, resisting blows while slowly wearing enemies down with heavy, earthen strikes.

Name: Digel
Description: A small burrowing critter that pops from the soil to strike before retreating underground.

Name: Dorrel
Description: Its hardened claws and thicker hide allow it to punish attackers that get too close.

Name: Gravorn
Description: A dominant ground beast that anchors itself firmly, striking back with crushing, tectonic force.

Name: Stonel
Description: A small rock-bodied creature that braces in place and slowly chips away at foes with steady, grinding blows.

Name: Gravel
Description: A compact rock beast that absorbs blows with layered stone and retaliates with heavy, deliberate strikes.

Name: Granor
Description: A hulking stone guardian that stands immovable, crushing enemies beneath overwhelming rocky force.

Name: Magorn
Description: A massive rock brute infused with lingering heat, advancing steadily while smashing foes with crushing, lava-hot stone.

Name: Skipel
Description: A quick-winged bug that darts erratically through the air, striking fast before slipping out of reach.

Name: Nibrel
Description: A jittery bug that bounces unpredictably, snapping at foes with quick pincers before they can react.

Name: Pinorn
Description: A sharp-eyed insect hunter that lunges suddenly, crushing enemies with powerful, well-timed pincer strikes.

Name: Aurel
Description: A nimble sky flier that swoops in with sharp pecks before darting away on swift wings.

Name: Fearel
Description: A sharp-eyed sky hunter that darts between air currents, striking swiftly before retreating upward.

Name: Skiron
Description: A seasoned aerial predator that exploits openings from above, tearing through foes with precise, wind-driven strikes.

Name: Tekon
Description: A small alloy construct that moves with careful precision, striking steadily while its reinforced body absorbs incoming blows.

Name: Coretek
Description: A rotating alloy sentinel that locks into position, grinding enemies down with precise mechanical force and reinforced plating.

Name: Ironyx
Description: A legendary alloy juggernaut forged around a living core, advancing relentlessly as its reinforced frame shrugs off all but the most powerful attacks.

Name: Wispel
Description: A faint specter that flickers in and out of view, slipping through attacks while draining foes with chilling, ghostly strikes.

Name: Graveil
Description: An elite specter that slips between moments, striking from shadowed angles before fading back into the veil.

Name: Shadeveil
Description: A legendary specter that weaves between reality and shadow, striking with silent precision before dissolving back into the veil.

Name: Umrel
Description: A small umbral creature that lashes out from darkened corners, retreating quickly as shadows close around it.

Name: Dreadnyx
Description: An umbral hunter that exploits openings from the dark, striking hard before melting back into shadow.

Name: Dreadveil
Description: A legendary shadow entity that phases through the veil itself, reappearing to deliver devastating, silent blows.

Name: Wyrrel
Description: A young wyrm that lunges wildly, scorching everything around it as it struggles to control its power.

Name: Wyrrax
Description: A more developed wyrm that crashes into enemies from above, trading its own safety for explosive damage.

Name: Drakon
Description: A fearsome wyrm that tears through enemies with savage aerial assaults, favoring overwhelming offense over self-preservation.

Name: Pyraxis
Description: A legendary wyrm whose focused, devastating strikes leave scorched ruin in their wake, ending battles in brutal, decisive blows.

Name: Orisel
Description: A quiet oracle wisp that studies its foe before acting, favoring foresight and careful, measured strikes.

Name: Prophel
Description: An imposing oracle enforcer that reads the flow of battle in advance, striking with decisive force guided by grim foresight.

Name: Divinel
Description: A mythic oracle being that peers far beyond the present moment, unleashing precise, inevitable strikes guided by absolute foresight.

Name: Clarel
Description: A feisty clash brawler that charges straight in, favoring constant pressure over caution.

Name: Claron
Description: A hardened clash fighter that builds momentum with every hit, driving foes back through sheer force.

Name: Brawlok
Description: A seasoned clash enforcer that trades blows head-on, growing stronger the longer it stays locked in brutal close combat.

Name: Clashorn
Description: A brutal clash juggernaut that thrives in prolonged combat, tearing into enemies with escalating, bone-crushing force.

Name: Morbel
Description: A warped sprout born of corruption, lurching forward with reckless strikes and unstable energy.

Name: Morbren
Description: A fully corrupted brute that thrives on chaos, smashing enemies with volatile force that grows more dangerous the longer it fights.

Name: Blightor
Description: A mythic avatar of corruption that radiates unstable power, overwhelming foes with catastrophic strikes fueled by rampant decay.

Name: Nightveil
Description: A boss-class umbral entity that tears through reality itself, phasing between shadows as it delivers devastating, unavoidable strikes.

Name: Stormek
Description: A colossal electric tyrant that builds lethal charge before unleashing battlefield-clearing bursts of lightning.

Name: Skyrend
Description: A supreme aerial predator that dominates the skies, striking from impossible angles with overwhelming speed and force.

Name: Pyroth
Description: A raging inferno incarnate that floods the battlefield with relentless flames, growing more destructive the longer it survives.

Name: Swarmor
Description: A nightmare hive mind that overwhelms foes through sheer numbers and relentless coordinated assault.
